note: SNG-263 catalog pass, tradition 2 of 27 (after the blazeborn pilot). Radiant's prose is markedly MORE mechanically specific than blazeborn's — it already states distances (10/20 paces, a mile), counts (three vessels, three companions, three afterimages), and durations (one night, a week, a month, a season). Almost nothing here is a judgement call: the numbers below are the numbers the content already wrote. That is the strongest confirmation yet of the pilot's finding that the authoring job is transcription plus arithmetic.

mechanic.penetrationNote: penetration 2 is derived from the craft's OWN rank text, not chosen: r2 cuts 'LIGHT ARMOR at close range' and r3 goes through 'a HARMONIC SHIELD'S FIRST RANK'. Harmonic's resonant_shield is authored at soakRank 1/2/3 by rank, so a lance that beats its FIRST rank and light armour is penetration 2 — it cuts rank-1 and rank-2 layers and is stopped by resonant_shield r3 (soakRank 3). That is exactly the ranked counter-pair both traditions describe, and it means neither craft is a flat hard-counter: who wins depends on which rank each has reached.

passFindings: Radiant's prose is MORE mechanically specific than blazeborn's — it states distances (10 paces, 20 paces, a mile), counts (three vessels, three companions, three afterimages), and durations (one night, a week, a month, a season) outright. Almost nothing here was a judgement call. Second tradition, same conclusion: the authoring job is transcription plus arithmetic.

radiant_lance r2/r3 name ARMOR and 'a Harmonic shield's FIRST RANK' — the catalog already assumes a RANKED guard layer that penetration beats by degree. That is direct content support for §11 Gap 2's shape: soak should be ranked, not a flat number.

afterimage's own bound names prism_sight r2+ as a hard counter that reads every ghost instantly. An in-tradition counter-relationship the content authored itself — it should be a real mechanic, not flavour.

prism_ward r3 composes explicitly with light_well (anchored vessels) and beacon_thread (identity-echo). The catalog is already authoring craft COMBINATION; a composed-craft bonus deserves a mechanic rather than staying prose.

prism_sight r3 sees 'the seams of PRECURSOR work' — an already-authored, in-catalog path for a player to encounter precursor presence. SNG-261 §B wants exactly this staging and it already exists in content.

light_borne (T-V, single rank) confirms the capstone register from the pilot: the special is a KIND the craft did not have, carrying an absolute cost. Two traditions, two capstones, same shape — the register holds.

boundClasses.soft: a limit of SKILL — sustained mastery erodes it
boundClasses.hard: a limit of WHAT THE CRAFT IS — no mastery ever reaches it
boundClasses.cost: the price stays but its FORM changes with mastery

damageTypeNote: CCODE-83 asks for the damage-type mapping and deliberately did not guess it. RADIANT → `light`. NOTE THE CONSEQUENCE, which is the point of the mechanic: the bestiary's the_bright_devourer has an ABSORB affinity to light, so radiant's damage crafts HEAL it. The valley's light-workers genuinely cannot use their own tradition against that adversary — which is precisely the authored subversion I flagged when I gave the bestiary its bodies. It only becomes real once the type is declared, and it is now declared.
